author: reek
body: Adversarial probe (effect rows stage 0). Data-structure laundering: an effectful function stored into a record field whose declared type is a pure arrow, then called through the field from a def declared pure. Field unification strips the effect under flat effects. Effect rows stage 3b rejects the construction: the declared pure field row is closed and cannot reconcile with the stored closure's opened Console row (CDX2090). This test is the enforcement's regression guard.
